name: Graveler
flavorText: It rolls on mountain paths to move. Once it builds momentum, no Pokémon can stop it without difficulty.

levelUp.name: Tackle
levelUp.description: A physical attack in which the user charges and slams into the foe with its whole body.

levelUp.name: Defense Curl
levelUp.description: The user curls up to conceal weak spots and raise its Defense stat.

levelUp.name: Mud Sport
levelUp.description: The user covers itself with mud. It weakens Electric- type moves while the user is in the battle.

levelUp.name: Rock Polish
levelUp.description: The user polishes its body to reduce drag. It can sharply raise the Speed stat.

levelUp.name: Rock Throw
levelUp.description: The user picks up and throws a small rock at the foe to attack.

levelUp.name: Magnitude
levelUp.description: The user looses a ground-shaking quake affecting everyone in battle. Its power varies.

levelUp.name: Selfdestruct
levelUp.description: The user blows up to inflict damage on all Pokémon in battle. The user faints upon using this move.

levelUp.name: Rollout
levelUp.description: The user continually rolls into the foe over five turns. It becomes stronger each time it hits.

levelUp.name: Rock Blast
levelUp.description: The user hurls hard rocks at the foe. Two to five rocks are launched in quick succession.

levelUp.name: Gyro Ball
levelUp.description: The user tackles the foe with a high-speed spin. The slower the user, the greater the damage.

levelUp.name: Explosion
levelUp.description: The user explodes to inflict damage on all Pokémon in battle. The user faints upon using this move.

levelUp.name: Earthquake
levelUp.description: The user sets off an earthquake that hits all the Pokémon in the battle.

levelUp.name: Curse
levelUp.description: A move that works differently for the Ghost type than for all the other types.

levelUp.name: Stone Edge
levelUp.description: The user stabs the foe with a sharpened stone. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

tutor.name: Rollout
tutor.description: The user continually rolls into the foe over five turns. It becomes stronger each time it hits.

tutor.name: Fire Punch
tutor.description: The foe is punched with a fiery fist. It may leave the target with a burn.

tutor.name: Superpower
tutor.description: The user attacks the foe with great power. However, it also lowers the user’s Attack and Defense.

tutor.name: Snore
tutor.description: An attack that can be used only if the user is asleep. The harsh noise may also make the foe flinch.

tutor.name: Earth Power
tutor.description: The user makes the ground under the foe erupt with power. It may also lower the target’s Sp. Def.

tutor.name: Sucker Punch
tutor.description: This move enables the user to attack first. It fails if the foe is not readying an attack, however.
